definitions.explanation: A painting or drawing whose main subject is a person or people, as a genre beside landscapes and still lifes.

examples.japanese: {人物画|じんぶつが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人物画|じんぶつが}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This painter is known for figure paintings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風景画|ふうけいが}→風景画：28196_fuukeiga⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{人物画|じんぶつが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people find painting people harder than painting landscapes.

notes:
One of the standard genres of painting, with ⟦{風景画|ふうけいが}→風景画：28196_fuukeiga⟧ (landscape) and ⟦{静物画|せいぶつが}→静物画：33245_seibutsuga⟧ (still life).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肖像画|しょうぞうが}→肖像画：23432_shouzouga⟧: a portrait of one particular person. {人物画|じんぶつが} is wider: any picture in which people are the subject, including scenes with many figures.
- ⟦{美人画|びじんが}→美人画：15570_bijinga⟧: pictures of beautiful women, a genre of ukiyo-e and later Japanese painting
